# Kawaki Studios — Full System Context & Architecture Guide

## Overview
Kawaki Studios is an independent digital engineering studio founded by Kunal Sharma. The studio bridges thoughtful visual design with disciplined web engineering, delivering bespoke web platforms, e-commerce storefronts, and automated workflows.

- **Website**: https://www.kawaki.co.in
- **Founder**: Kunal Sharma
- **Contact**: hello@kawakistudios.com / partners@kawakistudios.com
- **Headquarters**: New Delhi, India

## Core Engineering Disciplines

### 1. Custom Web Development
- Technologies: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Node.js, modern CSS.
- Architecture: Component-driven modular layouts, clean semantic HTML, API integrations, and server/client state management.
- Performance: Core Web Vitals optimization, asset budgeting, font optimization, and minimal runtime dependencies.

### 2. Shopify & E-commerce Development
- Technologies: Shopify Liquid, Storefront API, headless Next.js storefronts, GraphQL.
- Capabilities: Bespoke theme architecture, catalog structuring, checkout customization, and structured platform migrations.
- Architecture: Decoupled frontend models, optimized asset delivery, and resilient cart/checkout flows.

### 3. AI Automation & Workflow Engineering
- Technologies: n8n, Make, webhook orchestration, task-specific LLM workflows.
- Architecture: Deterministic business logic, error retry policies, structured payload validation, and data pipeline observability.

### 4. AI Search Optimization & Search Engineering
- Focus: Technical search optimization, entity modeling, Schema.org structured data, content architecture, and citation visibility across search engines and AI assistants.
- Principles: Evidence-based discoverability, semantic content hierarchies, and verifiable technical indexability.

### 5. WordPress Malware Removal & Recovery
- Focus: Post-compromise incident investigation, malicious code and script removal, database cleanup, backdoor investigation, and core hardening.
- Deliverables: Clean site restoration, patch application, security configuration, and monitoring guidance.
